name: levnet-moodle-integration
description: Independent access to Moodle and Levnet with secure calendar synchronization, downloads, and confirmed actions.

interface.shortDescription: Independent Moodle and Levnet student tools
interface.longDescription: An independent, unofficial student integration for JCT Moodle and Levnet. It connects a private Moodle calendar feed to Google Calendar, downloads reviewed files, and performs allowlisted actions through account-bound confirmations. Secrets stay in native dialogs and operating-system protected storage.
defaultPrompt: Set up Moodle, Levnet, and my Google Calendar.
Show my Moodle deadlines for the next two weeks.
Check whether Moodle and Levnet are connected.
